source_metadata.title: Heparin Resistance in SARS-CoV-2 Infected Patients with Venous Thromboembolism
source_metadata.design: IRB-approved retrospective medication-use evaluation / retrospective cohort

extraction_limitations: Extraction was limited to the uploaded primary article; cited references were not atomized.
The article contained three main tables and no main-text figures; table-derived atoms were anchored to table/row locators.
Some medians with IQRs contain two group-specific IQRs; the canonical statement preserves both, while the structured interval field represents the COVID-19-positive estimate and its IQR.
Bleeding could not be classified using full ISTH major/clinically relevant non-major bleeding criteria because the source itself reported those data were unavailable.
No data-availability statement was identified in the article, so no data_availability atom was created.
Atoms are machine-extracted and marked extracted, not human-verified.
